title: heap-buffer-overflow / SEGV: sqlite3Get4byte reads a page past the buffer
live_proof: fuzz-corpus diff: the image is from SQLite's post-3.22.0 fuzz corpus and reproduces on stock 3.22.0 under host ASan as heap-buffer-overflow in sqlite3Get4byte at sqlite3.c:29655
object: the page buffer sqlite3Get4byte reads a 4-byte big-endian value from
lifetime_ender: not a lifetime defect: a corrupt page header sends the read past the end of the page buffer
shape: read past the end of the record
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator, with a reconstructed trigger. The corpus entry carried only the database and an ASan log -- fuzzcheck pairs every database with every script and the provenance kept only the database id -- so the statement was re-derived by replaying candidate statements one process at a time against a fresh copy of the image. A cumulative script does not work here: an earlier statement leaves the image in a state the later one no longer reaches
